---
title: "From a spatial database to a public story"
---

This class project uses DuckDB Spatial to query the previous week's historical Census teaching extract.

- [Read the rendered notebook](report.ipynb) for the table and map.
- [Explore the plain HTML story page](website/index.html) for a custom website view of the same exports.

The data are synthetic historical Census dots assigned to 2015 Pennsylvania districts. Counts are sample dots, not population estimates, density, or current demographics.

## Method

Read local Parquet and GeoJSON files, transform geometries to a projected CRS, join points to polygons, and export summary files. This website serves those exports; it does not run Python or DuckDB on the server.
